d.d: A big cat, Panthera leo, native to Africa, India and formerly much of Europe.
d.x: Tigers and lions share a common ancestor from a few million years ago.

d.d: A male lion, as opposed to a lioness, which is characterized by having a flowing shaggy mane and taking little part in hunting, which can be done cooperatively.
Any of various extant and extinct big cats, especially the mountain lion.
Of the light brown color that resembles the fur of a lion.
A female lion (famous person regarded with interest and curiosity).
A player for England women's national football team
Any of various ray-finned fishes of the tribe Pteroini (especially of the genus Pterois) in the family Scorpaenidae.
